g.text: Dependencies: webrender_api, kurbo, euclid, app_units, log
SvgEngine struct — main entry point, stateless rendering API
Attribute string parsers — no Servo dependencies
Handle path geometry from SVG attributes
Handle coordinate list parsing from SVG attributes
Handle dimensional value parsing with CSS units
Convert shape + style → WebRender display items, vector only
Transform stack, clip stack, opacity stack management
Convert SVG gradients → WebRender gradient data
Module organization and public API surface
Bridge between Servo layout and SVG engine
Walk SVG DOM and dispatch rendering per element
Render text using Servo font system
Stylo CSS Engine — Computes per-element styles (style resolution phase)
Computes per element: Fill + Stroke + Opacity · Transform · Clip-path · Fonts · Animations · CSS inheritance
Produces: ServoArc<ComputedValues> on every DOM node
🚀 Entry Point — Delegates SVG rendering to the integration layer
Delegates to traverse_svg_tree(node, &layout_context, &mut wr) with DOM root, styles + viewport, and DisplayListBuilder.
Determines how SVG coordinates map to layout space
Gather gradients, clip paths, markers into a reference map
2c. Walk DOM Tree — Per-Element Processing Loop
Two-pass: collect defs (2b) → resolve on render — no DOM cloning
Renderer Pipeline — sequential per-element per-frame execution
Full transform matrix = context transform stack × element's own transform matrix
Parses translate/rotate/scale/skew/matrix() from SVG attribute, applies viewBox mapping
Create WebRender spatial node — independent coordinate system for transformed subtrees
Registers spatial node ID in WR scene; child elements render relative to this reference frame
Off-screen render-then-composite boundary for opacity < 1.0, mix-blend-mode, and filters
Nests per DOM hierarchy; each push/pop creates a WR render task boundary
Convert clip-path (basic shapes + url(#id)) and SVG <mask> into WR ClipChain primitives
GPU-accelerated intersection clipping — composed of multiple clip regions per element
Match SvgTag enum → push WR display item (rect, gradient, text) or create ClipChain
Rect/Circle/Ellipse → push_rect · Path → kurbo flatten + fill mesh · Text → push_text · Image → push_image · Use → resolve ref
Vector rendering pipeline · Per-item hit testing · GPU compositing
Native clipping · Gradient fills · Reference frame transforms

svg.text: ✦ Stateless engine renders fresh each frame — no cache invalidation, no serialization, no full re-render ✦
